title: Leading hypnosis questions about the Nine heard on tapes
summary: Greg tells of Leading hypnosis questions about the Nine heard on tapes, about 1970s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: speculation. Like on the tapes, you can very much hear him saying, you know, is it is it the nine

related.note: Hypnosis tapes in which Puharich himself suggests the Nine. This tells the Nine coming through under hypnosis as Puharich's leading questions rather than real contact, which is a different core claim about the same kind of session.

plain: A researcher named Greg talks about tape recordings from the 1970s made by Andrija Puharich, a researcher who hypnotised people who claimed contact with a group of beings called the Nine. Greg says that on the tapes you can clearly hear Puharich asking things like whether it is the Nine, suggesting he may have led the answers. If so, some of the messages said to come from the Nine may have been prompted by the questioner, a point that differs from the related story of the Nine coming through during a hypnosis session in Israel.
